reason: Successfully verified that the SuperAgent application can receive a user message and respond with the correct mathematical answer.
steps: Step 1 - Navigate to http://localhost:47891 — Successfully loaded the Gamut application homepage with sidebar visible showing two agents.
Step 2 - Find and click "QA-20260814-002418-snok" agent in sidebar — Successfully clicked on the agent link and navigated to its detail page.
Step 3 - Verify agent status is "running" or "idle" — Confirmed agent status is "idle" (visible in the UI as a status indicator showing "idle").

Step 4 - Send message "Hello! What is 2+2?" — Successfully typed the message in the message input field and clicked the Send button. The page navigated to the session view and the message was submitted to the agent.

Step 5 - Wait up to 3 minutes for a response — Agent processed the message and responded within the timeout period. The agent status transitioned from "working" back to "idle" after receiving the response.

Step 6 - Verify the response mentions "4" and take screenshot — The agent's response clearly displays "4" as a single message in the chat. The screenshot (agent-response-screenshot.png) captures the complete conversation showing both the user question and the agent's answer.
